summary: Oscar Piastri won the Qatar Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 1.9s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Alexander Albon made the biggest climb, from P17 to P7.
Charles Leclerc had a day to forget, dropping from P6 to P12.
The race was neutralised by 3 safety cars.
There were 3 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 0 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 184 points over Sergio Perez.
